purpose: Teach: スリップ/安部/スパイク/発光/王妃/ラケット/昆布/ノンフィクション

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、雨で、本当に、駐車場、車、スリップしそうになったわよ、危なかったわ、本当に。
lines.en: Aoi, I almost slipped in the parking lot today — the rain was really coming down. It was scary, honestly.
lines.style: Wry opening, warm complaint. Quick pace, almost amused at herself. Exhale of relief mixed with the memory of tension. Matter-of-fact delivery on the danger, then a small pullback.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。新スタッフの安部さん、本当に、頼もしい人ね、葵で、活躍してくれてるよ、絶対。
lines.en: Yeah. Abe, the new staff member — she's really turning out to be dependable. She's doing great things for us, honestly.
lines.style: Animated nod, genuine brightness. Lean forward slightly on the praise. Warm certainty in the voice. Not gushing, but openly appreciative.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: バレーボールの試合、彼、スパイク、本気で、決めてたよ、葵、見たかったわよね、絶対、すごい。
lines.en: At his volleyball match, the way he went for his spikes — he was really committing. You should have seen it, Aoi. It was something.
lines.style: Bright, almost dreamy quality. Softened middle — the memory of watching him play. Slight lift at 'something,' like she's still seeing it. Warm and present.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夜の店内、LED発光のディスプレイ、本気で、お洒落でしょ、葵で、お客様、感激してるわよ、絶対。
lines.en: You know, the way we've lit up the interior at night with those LED displays — it's really stylish, isn't it? The customers have been genuinely moved by it.
lines.style: Cheerful pride in the voice. Lift on 'stylish.' Quick, energetic delivery. She's sharing something she's excited about. Confidence without showing off.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃん、若い頃、王妃みたいな、本気で、優雅な人だったらしいよ、葵、本当に、すごいよね、絶対。
lines.en: My grandmother was apparently like a queen when she was young — truly elegant. You would have loved to see her, Aoi. She really was something.
lines.style: Wistful, almost reverent. Slow, gentle pace. Warmth mixed with a bittersweet touch — the reach backward in time. Trailing softly on the memory.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 彼、テニスのラケット、新しいの、買ったって、葵で、嬉しそうに、話してたよ、絶対、本気で、可愛い。
lines.en: He bought himself a new tennis racket, and the way he told me about it — he was so happy. It was really sweet.
lines.style: Soft, almost murmuring. Gentle smile audible. Slow, warm pacing. She's noticing the small joy in someone else's moment. Tender without being performative.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: おでんの昆布、本当に、葵の店、絶妙な、味、なのよね、本気で、好評、続いてるわね、絶対。
lines.en: The kombu in the oden at your shop — it's really something special, the way the flavor works. The customers keep coming back for it.
lines.style: Praising warmth. Confident nod on 'special.' Steady, assured delivery. She's seen something good and wants to name it. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 最近、ノンフィクション本、本気で、よく、読んでるのよ、私、葵で、面白い世界、知れるわよ、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: I've been reading a lot of nonfiction lately — there's something fascinating about discovering new worlds that way. It's been really rewarding.
lines.style: Reflective, almost contemplative. Thoughtful pace. She's sharing something she's discovering about herself. Quiet conviction. Close and genuine, like she's thinking aloud.
